title: Optimize Ensemble Subset Size — optimize_ensemble_subset
text: Post-ensemble optimization evaluates top-N subsets (ranked likelihood) selects N maximizes prediction quality. Produces separate mosaic_ensemble object optimal subset size, leaving original ensemble untouched. candidate size N (min_n full ensemble), function re-computes Gibbs weights within top-N subset, re-computes weighted median predictions 4D arrays, scores selected objective function.

title: Optimize Ensemble Subset Size — optimize_ensemble_subset
code: optimize_ensemble_subset(   ensemble,   likelihoods,   seeds = NULL,   min_n = 30L,   objective = c("mae", "r2_bias", "wis"),   central_method = "median",   stride = 1L,   cl = NULL,   verbose = TRUE )

title: Optimize Ensemble Subset Size — optimize_ensemble_subset
text: ensemble mosaic_ensemble object returned calc_model_ensemble. likelihoods Numeric vector log-likelihoods, one per parameter set ensemble. Must length ensemble$n_param_sets. seeds Optional numeric/integer vector simulation seeds aligned likelihoods. supplied, function returns optimal_seeds callers can map optimized subset back original samples.parquet rows without re-deriving internal sort. Separately, ensemble$seeds present (per-member seeds carried calc_model_ensemble, aligned cases_array construction), carried sort/slice exposed ensemble_optimized$seeds cases_array-aligned consumers medoid selection. argument ensemble$seeds serve different roles kept independent. min_n Minimum subset size evaluate. Default 30L guard small-subset KDE degeneracy optimized subset drives posterior artifacts. Fox et al. (2024) report 4 statistical minimum accuracy, posterior density estimation needs larger N. objective Scoring function: "mae" (default, normalized MAE), "r2_bias" (R-squared plus bias penalty), "wis" (normalized Weighted Interval Score). central_method Central tendency used summarize per-cell ensemble distribution "mae" "r2_bias" objectives recorded R^2/bias/MAE diagnostics: "median" (default, reproduces historical selection) "mean" (weighted mean, unbiased expected counts). Scalar per-channel c(cases=, deaths=). "wis" objective quantile-based unaffected setting (point forecast remains weighted median). default "median" deliberate – preserves historical direct-call selection Tier-2 bit--bit parity guarantee; run_MOSAIC() passes resolved control$predictions$central_method (package default "median" v0.46.1) explicitly. stride Integer >= 1. 1L (default) evaluates every N min_n:max_n (exhaustive, bit-identical parity path). > 1L enables coarse--refine two-stage search (see Details). Opt-; changes N's evaluated may select slightly different optimal_n exhaustive search. cl Optional parallel cluster (make_mosaic_cluster parallel::makeCluster) used split per-cell evaluation kernel across workers. NULL (default) runs serially. supplied, result bit--bit identical serial path. Must "PSOCK" cluster (FORK unsafe point pipeline). trivially small problems function falls back serial regardless cl. verbose Logical; TRUE, emit progress messages.

title: Optimize Ensemble Subset Size — optimize_ensemble_subset
text: S3 object class mosaic_subset_optimization containing: evaluation_table Data frame one row per N evaluated. stride > 1L contains coarse + refine N's, sorted N, every N min_n:max_n. optimal_n Selected subset size. optimal_score Score optimal N. optimal_weights Re-computed Gibbs weights optimal subset. optimal_indices Integer indices original ensemble arrays. optimal_seeds Simulation seeds optimal subset likelihood-sorted order, aligned optimal_weights (seeds supplied), else NULL. ensemble_optimized Complete mosaic_ensemble object optimal N. $seeds field per-member seed aligned cases_array (member--seed aligned) ensemble$seeds present, else falls back optimal_seeds. stability_flag TRUE score profile flat. diagnostics_n Original diagnostics-selected N. diagnostics_score Score diagnostics-selected N. objective objective used. central_method Resolved per-channel central tendency used "mae"/"r2_bias" scoring recorded diagnostics.

title: Optimize Ensemble Subset Size — optimize_ensemble_subset
text: evaluation loop organized cell-outer: [location, time] cell's finite predictions gathered scored across every candidate N (gather depend N), filling per-cell vector central tendencies. default call path (stride = 1L, cl = NULL) exhaustive serial guaranteed bit--bit identical historical implementation (Tier-2 parity). Two opt-speed levers available: PSOCK parallelism (cl): n_locations *     n_time_points cells split across supplied cluster's workers. result bit--bit identical serial path (worker runs kernel disjoint block cells; master scatters per-cell central/quantile values back [, j] positions). FORK clusters unsafe (native reticulate/numba threads loaded post-calibration point); pass "PSOCK" cluster. Stride--refine (stride): stride > 1L, coarse grid seq(min_n, max_n, = stride) evaluated first locate best N*, refinement bracket (N*-stride):(N*+stride) evaluated, selection logic runs combined (coarse + refine) rows. bit-identical exhaustive path: evaluation_table contains evaluated N's (fewer rows), selected optimal_n may differ slightly exhaustive optimum score profile non-monotone coarse points. trade roughly O(stride) reduction number N's evaluated.

text: Renders per-location, time-varying Cori (2013) instantaneous infection effective reproductive number \(R_{jt}\) produced calc_Reff. headline line medoid trajectory R_t (central) drawn bold purple line date, horizontal reference line \(R_{\mathrm{eff}} = 1\). medoid single coherent member trajectory preserves timing height epidemic's R_t peak (typically 2-3.3), unlike per-calendar-day cross-member median flattens phase-misaligned peaks toward 1.

Leading warm-rows non-finite central dropped per location gap artifact plotted. show_iqr Logical. Draw inner 50\ addition faint 95\ medoid line faint 95\ back-compatibility. smooth_days Integer. Centered rolling-mean window (days) applied medoid central line display. daily Cori R_t single trajectory noisy; smoothing yields readable trend raw daily series kept faint background true per-member daily peak reported annotation. Model pred_median: solid line + full-opacity CI ribbon dates \(\le\) cutoff; solid line + lighter CI ribbon cutoff (distinguished dashed cutoff rule) (clipped forecast_display_months). Color Scale Definition: Defines distinct color scales cumulative doses distributed (green gradient) proportion vaccinated (purple gradient), including appropriate breaks labels. Barplot Generation: Constructs barplots metric, ordering countries descending values applying corresponding color scales. title: Default prior distributions for MOSAIC model parameters — priors_default
text: Transmission FOI structure: alpha_2 – Exponent N_jt FOI denominator (Beta). 1 = frequency-dependent transmission; 0 = density-dependent. single global scalar (alpha_1 now per-location – see ). kappa – Half-saturation V. cholerae concentration environmental dose-response 50\ capacity). Environmental persistence (V. cholerae decay water): decay_days_short – Short-end decay timescale (Truncnorm, days). decay_days_spread – Spread used derive decay_days_long = decay_days_short + decay_days_spread (Truncnorm). decay_days_long derived sampling time first-class prior. decay_shape_1, decay_shape_2 – Truncnorm shape coefficients Beta-shaped mapping suitability $\psi$ decay rate (natural-infection immunity decay). Disease progression (rates, per day): iota – Incubation rate E -> (Lognormal; rate, period). Prior median ~0.71/day. gamma_1 – Symptomatic shedding-duration rate I_1 -> R (Lognormal). Prior median 0.1/day (~10-day shedding); 95\ ~3.75 - 26.6 days. gamma_2 – Asymptomatic shedding-duration rate I_2 -> R (Lognormal). Prior median 0.5/day (~2-day shedding); 95\ ~0.91 - 4.39 days. epsilon – Natural-infection immunity waning rate R -> S (Lognormal). Prior mean 3.9e-4/day -> ~7-yr immunity (King et al. 2008 + project's two-cohort re-fit). Vaccination (OCV): phi_1, phi_2 – One-dose / two-dose vaccine effectiveness moment dose delivery (Beta). omega_1, omega_2 – One-dose / two-dose vaccine-induced immunity waning rates (Gamma, per day). Symptom expression, care-seeking, surveillance: sigma – Fraction infections symptomatic (Beta). rho – Care-seeking rate: probability symptomatic individual presents surveillance (Beta; reporting fraction). rho_deaths – Surveillance capture rate true cholera deaths (Beta; random-effects meta-analysis Routh 2017, Shikanga 2009, Bwire 2013 — see MOSAIC-pkg/claude/rho_deaths_research/SYNTHESIS_REPORT.md). Consumed laser-cholera v0.13+ deaths likelihood: observed surveillance reported_deaths compared simulated reported_deaths = round(disease_deaths * rho_deaths) (lagged delta_reporting_deaths). Production prior recommended prediction-interval variant Beta(6.30, 8.52); informative variant Beta(36.95, 51.02) retained sensitivity per SYNTHESIS_REPORT sec 3.4. chi_endemic, chi_epidemic – Positive predictive value among suspected cases endemic vs epidemic phases (Beta). delta_reporting_cases – Symptom-onset--surveillance-report delay (Truncnorm, days). infection--report – incubation handled separately E compartment iota. delta_reporting_deaths – Death-event--death-report delay days (Truncnorm). time true cholera death appearance surveillance reports. symptom-onset--death interval implicit SEIR dynamics (\(\gamma_1^{-1}\) ~ 5-7 days symptomatic recovery/death). Consumed laser-cholera v0.13+ infectious.py:88-92 reported_deaths[t] = round(disease_deaths[t-delta] * rho_deaths). Environmental shedding intensity (V. cholerae cells per person per day): zeta_1 – Symptomatic shedding rate (Lognormal). zeta_2 – Asymptomatic shedding rate (Lognormal). Also first-class prior, typically derived sampling time zeta_1 / zeta_ratio rather drawn independently. zeta_ratio – zeta_1 / zeta_2 (Lognormal; ~5-OOM literature spread retained intentionally). Mobility (gravity-model exponents): mobility_gamma, mobility_omega – Distance-decay population-scaling exponents (Gamma).

title: Default prior distributions for MOSAIC model parameters — priors_default
text: carries per-iso prior parameters_location$<param>$location$<ISO3>. Distribution family across isos given parameter (noted ); hyperparameters differ (except alpha_1, uses shared marginal across isos). Transmission contact: alpha_1 – FOI mixing exponent infectious term (Beta; 0 = mixing, 1 = well-mixed). Relocated global per-location (v15.16) shared informative Beta(28.4, 71.6) every iso; engine applies elementwise per patch (scalar alpha_1 still accepted broadcast national/legacy configs). beta_j0_tot – Total baseline transmission rate per location (Lognormal). beta_j0_hum beta_j0_env derived p_beta * beta_j0_tot (1 - p_beta) * beta_j0_tot; neither directly sampled. p_beta – Fraction total transmission attributable direct human--human contact (Beta). tau_i – Daily departure probability per location, gravity model (Beta). theta_j – WASH-coverage fraction per location (Beta). Seasonality (Fourier coefficients, fit cases): a_1_j, a_2_j, b_1_j, b_2_j – Annual + semi-annual Fourier coefficients (Normal). Earlier doc versions erroneously labelled b_1/b_2 "deaths" – four fitted cases. Initial conditions (per-compartment proportions population t=0): prop_S_initial, prop_V1_initial, prop_V2_initial, prop_E_initial, prop_I_initial, prop_R_initial – Beta priors per iso. Generated est_initial_S/V1_V2/E_I/R() demography, surveillance history, OCV campaigns, etc. Disease-mortality: mu_j_baseline – Per-iso baseline CFR rate (Gamma). mu_j_slope – Per-iso slope coupling CFR outbreak intensity (Gamma). mu_j_epidemic_factor – Per-iso multiplier applied mu_j_baseline epidemic phase detected (Gamma). Phase switching: epidemic_threshold – Per-iso I_sym / N threshold chi_epidemic mu_j_epidemic_factor engage (Truncnorm). Environmental-suitability calibration (used LSTM $\psi$ pipeline): psi_star_a – Gain logit-scale suitability score (Truncnorm). psi_star_b – Logit-scale offset (Normal). psi_star_z – Smoothing weight causal EWMA (Beta). psi_star_k – Time-offset (lag) parameter (Truncnorm).

text: flood label unchanged (Disaster Type == "Flood"). cyclone label SEPARATE series built Disaster Type == "Storm" restricted Disaster Subtype %% c("Tropical cyclone", "Storm surge") – crisply-dated, water-producing storm events (49 events / ~74 active weeks 2026-05 extract). Storm (General), Severe weather, Lightning/Thunderstorms, Tornado, Hail, Blizzard/Winter storm deliberately EXCLUDED: reliably water-producing dilute cyclone signal. Tropical cyclones previously silently dropped flood-filter, neutering downstream flood GAM's wind smooth; separate cyclone series feeds dedicated wind/coastal GAM (impute_cyclone_probability). EM-DAT records carry frequent missing day--month occasional missing end-month values. Imputation rules: Missing Start Day End Day -> 15. Missing End Month -> Start Month. Missing End Year -> Start Year. resulting end_date earlier start_date (data-entry artifact), reset start_date. event expanded unique set ISO-8601 (year, week) pairs touched daily date range start_date:end_date. panel grid full Cartesian product iso_codes_mosaic ISO-weeks date_start latest event end-week; cells flood activity carry zeros, downstream left-join suitability table need impute missingness. EM-DAT records events meeting CRED's inclusion thresholds (>=10 deaths, >=100 affected, formal emergency declaration), covariate captures major flood occurrences rather continuous flood intensity. richer continuous signal lives OpenMeteo precipitation/anomaly covariates.

title: Download, Process, and Save Historical Annual WHO Cholera Data for Africa — process_WHO_annual_data
text: Data sources: 1949-2021: annual reports compiled World Data. See https://ourworldindata.org. 2022: Manually transcribed 2022 annual cholera report (PDF). 2023+: Downloaded Global Cholera & AWD dashboard via ArcGIS. download archived raw//annual/who_global_dashboard/cholera_adm0_public_snapshot_YYYY-MM-DD.csv files matching cholera_adm0_public_*.csv dashboard directory ingested. row's actual coverage derived first_epiwk / last_epiwk (rolling snapshots cross calendar-year boundaries – see year-labeling note ). Year labeling: ArcGIS dashboard returns one row per country summing case_total / death_total first_epiwk last_epiwk. row assigned calendar year contains majority days. coverage_days reports many calendar days covered, year_fraction = coverage_days/365.25 indicates whether row full-year observation (~1.0) partial snapshot (<1.0). multiple files row (iso_code, year) combination, row larger coverage_days kept. refresh given calendar year: place year-filtered CSV raw//annual/who_global_dashboard/ named cholera_adm0_public_YYYY.csv (downloaded dashboard UI year filter applied). Re-run process_WHO_annual_data(). Outputs (PATHS$DATA_WHO_ANNUAL): who_afro_annual.csv – current full series, columns country, iso_code, region, year, cases_total,         cases_imported, deaths_total, cfr, cfr_lo, cfr_hi, first_epiwk,         last_epiwk, coverage_days, year_fraction, source. Intermediate per-source slices traceability.

title: Rolling-Window Forecast Validation for the MOSAIC Transmission Model — run_rolling_cv
text: function fit--forecast engine : produces calibrations, projections, one organized predictions artifact. compute evaluation metrics, baselines, skill scores – done post-hoc reading predictions.parquet. Window. -sample () start fixed config$date_start (anchor); simulation runs full config window (config$date_start .. config$date_stop). cutoff T calibration likelihood scores weeks \(\le T\) (observations T masked NA); post-T portion simulation forecast. embargo_weeks gap separates stop (T) OOS start (T + embargo); embargo week neither trained labeled OOS. Leakage discipline. psi re-fit per cutoff fit_date_stop = T; harness owns leakage-critical date arguments est_suitability overrides date keys passed via est_suitability_spec (warning). est_suitability_spec therefore controls modeling choices (target, features, architecture), cutoff window. Coupled metapopulation. iso may single country vector; vector runs coupled metapopulation (one calibration per cutoff covering listed locations). Thus one run_MOSAIC calibration per cutoff (per country). Outputs. dir_output: manifest.json (settings + per-run index status), predictions.parquet (compiled long table), runs/cutoff_<T>/ (native run_MOSAIC directory cutoff). predictions.parquet derived view – can rebuilt run directories compile_rolling_cv_predictions. predictions table one row per (cutoff x location x date x metric) columns: run_id, iso_code, anchor_date, cutoff_date, date, metric, segment (/embargo/OOS), weeks_ahead, horizon_bucket, observed, observed_source, pred_central (scored series), pred_mean, pred_median, central_method, CI columns (pi*_lo/pi*_hi). observed held-(unmasked) trusted surveillance value, OOS rows carry real target post-hoc scoring.

NULL, use MOSAIC::config_default. seed Random seed reproducible sampling (required). sample_args Named list logical values controlling parameters sample. element named sample_[parameter] logical value. Available options include: sample_alpha_1: Population mixing within metapops (default TRUE) sample_alpha_2: Degree frequency driven transmission (default FALSE; pinned, weakly identified) sample_decay_days_short: Minimum V. cholerae survival (default TRUE) sample_decay_days_spread: Spread min max V. cholerae survival; decay_days_long derived short + spread (default TRUE) sample_decay_shape_1: First Beta shape decay (default TRUE) sample_decay_shape_2: Second Beta shape decay (default TRUE) sample_epsilon: Immunity (default TRUE) sample_gamma_1: Recovery rate (default TRUE) sample_gamma_2: Recovery rate (default TRUE) sample_iota: Incubation rate (default TRUE) sample_kappa: V. cholerae 50 percent infectious dose concentration (default TRUE) sample_mobility_gamma: Mobility distance decay parameter (default TRUE) sample_mobility_omega: Mobility population scaling parameter (default TRUE) sample_omega_1: Vaccine waning rate one dose (default TRUE) sample_omega_2: Vaccine waning rate two doses (default TRUE) sample_phi_1: Initial vaccine effectiveness one dose (default TRUE) sample_phi_2: Initial vaccine effectiveness two doses (default TRUE) sample_chi_endemic: PPV among suspected cases endemic periods (default TRUE) sample_chi_epidemic: PPV among suspected cases epidemic periods (default TRUE) sample_rho: Care-seeking rate (default TRUE) sample_sigma: Symptomatic fraction (default TRUE) sample_zeta_1: Symptomatic shedding rate (default TRUE) sample_zeta_ratio: Symptomatic--asymptomatic shedding ratio (default TRUE) sample_beta_j0_tot: Total transmission rate (default TRUE) sample_p_beta: Proportion human--human transmission (default TRUE) sample_tau_i: Diffusion (default TRUE) sample_theta_j: WASH coverage (default TRUE) sample_a_1_j: Seasonality (default TRUE) sample_a_2_j: Seasonality (default TRUE) sample_b_1_j: Seasonality (default TRUE) sample_b_2_j: Seasonality (default TRUE) sample_CFR_target: Per-country target reported case-fatality ratio (B2 lognormal location prior). priors object carries CFR_target location prior, gates whether CFR_target drawn (TRUE) held config default / prior median (FALSE) (default TRUE) sample_mu_j_baseline: B2 (priors object CFR_target location prior) gates derivation mu_j_baseline CFR_target * (1 - exp(-gamma_1)) * rho / (rho_deaths * chi_epidemic) (B2.1 engine-correct chain factor) rather independent draw; mu_j_baseline longer independently sampled location parameter. legacy priors object (CFR_target prior) gates old independent mu_j_baseline draw. (default TRUE) sample_mu_j_slope: Location-specific temporal IFR trend (default TRUE) sample_mu_j_epidemic_factor: Location-specific epidemic IFR multiplier (default TRUE) sample_epidemic_threshold: Location-specific epidemic activation threshold (default TRUE) sample_delta_reporting_cases: Infection--case reporting delay days (default TRUE) sample_delta_reporting_deaths: Infection--death reporting delay days (default TRUE) sample_psi_star_a: Suitability calibration shape/gain (default TRUE) sample_psi_star_b: Suitability calibration scale/offset (default TRUE) sample_psi_star_z: Suitability calibration smoothing (default TRUE) sample_psi_star_k: Suitability calibration time offset (default TRUE) sample_initial_conditions: Initial condition proportions (default TRUE) ic_moment_match: Derive E/observed week-1 cases sampled reporting chain (sigma, rho, chi_endemic, iota). active sample_initial_conditions TRUE. title: MOSAIC 0.32.6
text: R/get_rho_care_seeking_params.R now anchors rho prior random-effects meta-analytic pool Wiens et al. 2025 case-definition strata, replacing prior pool 12 GEMS Nasrin 2013 pediatric MSD strata + 1 Wiens severe/cholera summary. Anchors (Wiens et al. 2025, PMC12013865): - General diarrhea: 29.9% [25.3, 35.1] 122 observations - Severe diarrhea + cholera: 58.6% [39.9, 75.2] 22 observations Pooled prior: Beta(5.38, 7.10), mean 0.423, 95% CI [0.21, 0.65], ESS ≈ 12.5 (: Beta(6.81, 17.89), mean 0.276, 95% CI [0.12, 0.46], ESS ≈ 25). change: 1. Severity match. Symptomatic cholera spans full mild--severe spectrum. Anchoring severe-stratum biases rho upward (severe-dominated outbreak-response settings); anchoring general diarrhea alone biases rho downward (includes many self-resolving mild episodes). Pooling honestly reflects severity distribution. 2. GEMS already included via Wiens. Dimensional fix. prior pool weighted 12 GEMS stratum-level observations 1 Wiens meta-analytic summary — upside-vs Wiens’s 23-study underlying meta-analysis. new pool treats Wiens stratum (122 + 22 obs) one observation meta-analysis. 4. Cascading mu_j_baseline update. steady-state CFR identity mu_j_baseline = CFR × rho / (rho_deaths × chi) propagates rho change: per-country mu_j_baseline values rescale ~1.5× (0.423 / 0.276). what: rho_deaths informative prior from SSA meta-analysis
title: MOSAIC 0.30.47
text: rho_deaths default prior replaced (Beta(3, 2) → Beta(36.95, 51.02)) default value drops 0.6 0.42. Methodology. Random-effects (DerSimonian-Laird, logit-scale) meta-analysis three Sub-Saharan African studies — Routh 2017 (Tanzania, EID; binomial CI 48/101), Shikanga 2009 (Kenya, AJTMH; approximate binomial CI implied ~25/73), Bwire 2013 (Uganda, PLOS NTDs; sensitivity range). Inverse-variance weighting yields Routh 53%, Shikanga 42%, Bwire 5% — Bwire’s wide CI auto--weights . Pooled mean 0.419 (essentially identical earlier ad-hoc 3:2 quality-weighted mean 0.417). Informative variant. Beta fit 95% CI pooled mean (prediction interval) gives Beta(36.95, 51.02), mean 0.420, 95% CI [0.319, 0.524], ESS ~88. Methodology mirrors R/get_rho_care_seeking_params.R (cases-side rho), establishing parallel statistical machinery two observation-model detection probabilities. Previous attribution Finger et al. 2024 corrected — paper editorial without quantitative anchor; 23–96% range cited belonged Pampaka et al. 2025 described place death, surveillance capture. Full provenance: claude/rho_deaths_research/SYNTHESIS_REPORT.md.

what: Flood-prob GAM: select=TRUE shrinkage + precip-window tensor product
title: MOSAIC 0.30.25
text: Two changes validated independently software-engineer agent statistical-modeler agent running parallel experiments separate sandboxes. converged (1); modeler additionally identified (2): Replace iterative p-value pruning loop single bam() fit using select = TRUE. Smoothness null-space shrinkage mgcv’s principled mechanism driving uninformative smooths’ coefficients toward zero. v0.30.24 -sample-p-value pruning multicollinearity-sensitive (docstring already documented caveat) produced fragile drop sequences. select=TRUE delivers equivalent CV AUC (0.851 -> 0.852 SWE experiments) +2.6 +4.2 percentile-point lift worst-detected cyclone (Kenneth 2019, 71.6 74.2 production change). Removes prune_p_threshold prune_max_iter args + pruning_log diagnostic. Single ~10-second fit replaces iterative ~30-60s loop. Replace s(precip_sum_4w) + s(precip_sum_24w) te(precip_sum_4w, precip_sum_24w, k = c(10, 10)). “heavy 4-week rain already-saturated catchment (6-month antecedent)” interaction genuinely jointly nonlinear; tensor captures univariates plus existing precip_x_soil_anom approximated crudely. Modeler-agent experiment: cyclone median percentile rank 91.6 -> 93.8 (+2.2), top-5% hits 3 -> 4. End--end production cyclone benchmark (re-measured): Idai MOZ 2019-W11 pctile = (run pending) Idai MWI 2019-W11 Idai ZWE 2019-W11 Kenneth MOZ 2019-W17 Eloise MOZ 2021-W04 Ana MOZ 2022-W04 Ana MWI 2022-W04 Gombe MOZ 2022-W11 Freddy-1 MOZ 2023-W08 Freddy-2 MOZ 2023-W11 Tested rejected agents: nthreads (-op macOS), method = REML/ML/GCV.Cp (metric change impractically slow), bs = "ad" adaptive smoothers, k = 20+ precip windows (overfit), bs = "cr" cubic regression (change), per-country = iso_code_f smooths (overfit), nested random effects, cloglog link, quasibinomial, betabinomial, Tweedie log1p(affected), smoothed +/-2w binary target, class weighting (trades AUC cyclone recall). Caveat surfaced agents: country-stratified 5-fold CV AUC drops 0.72 (vs 0.85 random folds). model’s lift comes country random effect; climate predictors less work random-fold CV suggests. model fail badly country training data. Worth keeping mind interpreting imputed flood_prob --sample country setting.

title: MOSAIC 0.30.23
text: v0.30.22 Tweedie--severity formulation made Cyclone Freddy stand MOZ’s #1 historical week (headline visual goal) 10-cyclone benchmark across Idai 2019 (MOZ/MWI/ZWE), Kenneth 2019, Eloise 2021, Ana 2022 (MOZ/MWI), Gombe 2022, Freddy 2023 (x2 landfalls) showed Tweedie variant -detects catastrophic events – median percentile rank 81.4, minimum 77.8. root cause: Tweedie target chases EM-DAT’s logged Total Affected, Idai’s Total Affected logged smaller real impact warranted, model -amplified . release reverts family + target v0.30.21 (binomial logit emdat_flood_active 0/1) keeping four physics-driven predictor enrichments v0.30.22 S2 exploration found load-bearing: s(precip_sum_24w) – ~6-month basin saturation memory (inline-computed) s(precip_sum_52w) – annual antecedent precipitation (inline-computed) s(precip_sum_4w, = region_f) – region-conditional 4-week precip smooth s(precip_x_soil_anom) – joint precip-anomaly x soil-moisture-anomaly index Result: median cyclone percentile rank 93.2 (vs 81.4 Tweedie, 90.8 v0.30.21 baseline), minimum 79.1 (every cyclone-week top 21% country’s history). Three cyclones top 5%. Output now naturally [0, 1] logit link – global-max scaling needed. Test thresholds restored binomial-appropriate AUC > 0.80 mean(hi)-mean(lo) > 0.3 discrimination tests.

what: Flood-prob imputer: Tweedie severity target + enriched predictors
title: MOSAIC 0.30.22
text: v0.30.20 binomial--active formulation produced imputed emdat_flood_prob didn’t separate major events seasonal climatology – Cyclone Freddy (MOZ, Feb-Mar 2023) reached probability 0.503, barely MOZ Feb-Apr p90 0.396 -time MOZ max. Four parallel strategies explored (Tweedie severity target; enriched predictor set; xgboost; two-stage hurdle). release adopts hybrid two winners: Tweedie family raw Total Affected. Encodes flood SEVERITY rather just presence/absence. Tweedie compound-Poisson-gamma mixture handles zero-inflated continuous target natively. Enriched predictor set (computed inline imputer, upstream compile changes required beyond existing region column): precip_sum_24w precip_sum_52w – long-memory antecedent precipitation capturing basin saturation. largest single contributors interannual variance rebuild experiments. s(precip_sum_4w, = region_f) – region-conditional 4-week precipitation smooth (4-region classification: Central / East / Southern / West Africa). s(precip_x_soil_anom) – joint precip-anomaly x soil-moisture-anomaly index “-wet already-saturated” regime. Output normalization: predictions raw Tweedie scale non-negative, heavy-tailed continuous. Normalized global maximum [0, 1] – rank-normalization tested rejected erases long-tail major-event amplification Tweedie target chosen . End--end measured impact (full AFRO panel, real climate + EM-DAT data): Cost: 0.05 AUC 0.02 Spearman held-binary-target metrics (unavoidable switching binomial--binary Tweedie--continuous). Acceptable trade-given 6.4x lift Freddy benchmark 63% reduction seasonal-variance share. Strategies tested rejected: xgboost (sharper peaks worsened seasonal share); two-stage hurdle (Freddy peak actually dropped Total Affected Freddy isn’t global outlier).

what: Flood-probability GAM: rebuild around hydrological drivers + ENSO/IOD
title: MOSAIC 0.30.20
text: Variance decomposition v0.30.19’s imputed emdat_flood_prob showed highest-flood-activity countries (NGA 92%, TCD 83%, SSD 83%, MLI 75%, ETH 75%) heavily dominated seasonal pattern, summary(model) revealed cyclic-week country-RE terms plus raw 12-week rainfall sum carried virtually explanatory power every anomaly/teleconnection term shrunk select = TRUE penalty. release rebuilds GAM formula around variables ostensibly linked flood physics, removes seasonal / static-baseline channels crowding climate-driven interannual signal: Removed s(week, bs = "cc") (cyclic seasonality), elevation, urban_population_pct. country random effect alone absorbs remaining country-level baseline differences. Removed s(temp_anom) — temperature isn’t direct flood driver AFRO (snowmelt). Added every precipitation channel: precipitation_sum, precip_anom, precip_sum_2w/4w/8w/12w, plus binary precip_extreme_p90_count extreme-rain trigger. Added soil moisture (raw + anomaly), atmospheric humidity (raw + 12w rolling), storm/cyclone proxy wind_speed_10m_max. what: Code-review fixes in compile_suitability_data and est_suitability
title: MOSAIC 0.30.19
text: Round correctness fixes surfaced internal code review: B1 — est_suitability() date auto-detection referenced d_all$date_start / enso_complete$date_stop, columns compile_suitability_data() drops saving. min(NULL, na.rm=TRUE) silently returns Inf propagated bogus dates. Fixed use d_all$date. B2 — Fine-tuning splits trained wrong target scale. model output head activation = "linear", name = "logit_head" first split correctly fed qlogis()-transformed targets. Subsequent fine-tuning splits (default n_splits = 10) fed raw [0, 1] probabilities, pushing linear head toward wrong range silently undoing first split’s training. Now applies qlogis(pmax(eps, pmin(1-eps, ...))) consistently. B3 — seasonal_outbreak_risk computed mean(cases_lagged) inside group_by(iso_code) %>% mutate(...), producing single per-country mean rather week--year climatology comment claimed. Now uses stats::ave(cases_lagged, week, FUN = mean) give intended weekly seasonality. B4 — weeks_since_major_outbreak incremented counter memory_lag warm-window (default 17 weeks forecast mode), producing fake 1, 2, 3, ... values lag target NA. Now stays NA first real observation. B5 — ISO week 53. Investigated documented. Two distinct things happening: () legitimate W53 2015 2020 dropped (~80 country-weeks, 0.2% training data); (b) upstream bug process_open_meteo_data emits spurious W53 entries labelled calendar year ISO years 2005/2010/2016/2021. drop--W53 filter robustly handles (b). Added comment block explaining trade-; upstream fix process_open_meteo_data structural follow-(separate ticket). B6 — Vaccination weekly key paired lubridate::isoweek(date) format(date, "%Y") (calendar year). Dates near year boundary (e.g., 2024-12-30, ISO 2025-W01) joining (year=2024, week=1), silently missing right upstream row. Now uses lubridate::isoyear(). B7 — pivot_wider climate ENSO values_fn, residual duplicate (iso_code, year, week, variable) row silently produce list-columns break every downstream merge. Now passes values_fn = mean. B8 — est_suitability() plotting block gated (T) (always ) comment claiming “disabled default”, par(mfrow = c(2,1)) leaked caller’s device state. Replaced real plot_country_diagnostics = FALSE argument .exit(par(old_par)). B9 — Positional column renames (names(x)[3] <- "...") replaced dplyr::rename() upstream column reorder can’t silently corrupt downstream values. B10 — Negative case counts est_suitability() now flagged warning clamped 0 (previously silent). B11 — Duplicate identical df <- data.frame(...) block est_suitability() removed. B12 — Dead first covariates_all assignment est_suitability() removed; comprehensive (live) assignment remains.
